boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten documented, named stops on corridors in the practical University of Oregon orbit.

cards.entity_name: The Duck Store Flagship Campus Store
cards.title: Duck Store supplies stop
cards.subtitle: East 13th Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use the flagship store at 895 E. 13th Avenue when you need course materials or campus-oriented supplies; check the official store page before making a special trip.
cards.short_summary: A named East 13th store serving University of Oregon students, faculty, and staff.
cards.evidence_claim: The Duck Store lists its Flagship Campus Store at 895 E. 13th Ave. and says it has served University of Oregon students, faculty, and staff since 1920.
cards.access_notes: Flagship Campus Store: 895 E. 13th Ave., Eugene.

cards.title: Franklin grocery provisions
cards.subtitle: Franklin Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Stop at 1960 Franklin Boulevard for produce, bulk foods, and prepared-food counters. The official location page lists daily hours, so confirm them if your timing matters.
cards.short_summary: A Franklin Boulevard market near the university and Knight Campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Market of Choice identifies its Franklin market at 1960 Franklin Blvd., near the University of Oregon and Knight Campus, with produce, bulk foods, and prepared-food departments.
cards.access_notes: 1960 Franklin Blvd.; the official page lists daily hours of 7 a.m.–9 p.m.

cards.title: Franklin pharmacy errand
cards.subtitle: Franklin Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Use this named Franklin Boulevard pharmacy for a straightforward health-and-personal-care errand; contact the pharmacy directly for prescription or service questions.
cards.short_summary: A documented pharmacy location along the Franklin Boulevard campus edge.
cards.evidence_claim: Hirons Pharmacy lists its Hirons Franklin location at 1950 Franklin Boulevard in Eugene.
cards.access_notes: 1950 Franklin Boulevard, Eugene; call the pharmacy for service details.

cards.title: Downtown Library study reset
cards.subtitle: West 10th Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Head to the Downtown Library at 100 West 10th Avenue for public information and study resources. Check its city-posted schedule, especially around holidays.
cards.short_summary: A city library branch with current, posted downtown hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Eugene lists the Downtown Library at 100 W. 10th Avenue and describes Eugene Public Library as providing free access to information, education, and entertainment.
cards.source_title: Eugene Public Library Hours and Locations
cards.access_notes: 100 W. 10th Avenue; city-posted hours vary by day and holiday.

cards.title: Park Blocks market day
cards.subtitle: 8th Avenue and Oak Street corridor
cards.notes: Plan this stop for a Saturday during the April-to-mid-November season. Browse the Park Blocks, and use the market’s current page to confirm dates and vendor details.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal, open-air market in the downtown Park Blocks.
cards.evidence_claim: Eugene Saturday Market states that it is held at the Park Blocks at 8th and Oak in downtown Eugene on Saturdays from April through mid-November, with free admission.
cards.source_title: Eugene Saturday Market FAQ for Visitors
cards.access_notes: Downtown Park Blocks at 8th and Oak; Saturdays, 10 a.m.–4 p.m., April through mid-November.

cards.entity_name: Hult Center for the Performing Arts
cards.title: Willamette performance calendar
cards.subtitle: Willamette Street corridor
cards.notes: Check the performance calendar and ticket availability before heading downtown. The City of Eugene-operated venue sits between 6th and 7th Avenues on Willamette Street.
cards.short_summary: A city-operated performing-arts venue in central downtown.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hult Center says it is operated by the City of Eugene and is located at One Eugene Center, 7th and Willamette, with more than 700 events and performances annually.
cards.access_notes: One Eugene Center, 7th and Willamette; ticket office hours are posted on the venue page.

cards.title: Fifth Avenue market hall
cards.subtitle: East 5th Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Walk the market’s shops and public spaces at 296 East 5th Avenue, then consult the official directory or event calendar for the specific business or program you want.
cards.short_summary: A named public market complex with shops, eateries, and events.
cards.evidence_claim: 5th Street Public Market lists its address as 296 E. 5th Ave. and describes shops, eateries, public spaces, and a current events calendar.
cards.access_notes: 296 E. 5th Ave.; general market hours and individual-business hours are listed separately.

cards.title: Leo Harris science stop
cards.subtitle: Leo Harris Parkway corridor
cards.notes: Choose this Alton Baker Park stop for hands-on science exhibits or a planetarium program. Review the center’s admission and program information before you go.
cards.short_summary: A nonprofit hands-on science museum and planetarium in Alton Baker Park.
cards.evidence_claim: Eugene Science Center identifies itself as Lane County’s hands-on science museum and planetarium, located at 2300 Leo Harris Parkway in Alton Baker Park.
cards.access_notes: 2300 Leo Harris Parkway, Eugene; review current admission and program details before visiting.

cards.title: Autzen game-day landmark
cards.subtitle: Martin Luther King Jr. Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Use the official athletics page for event and arrival planning. On game days, parking rules and entry timing can differ from ordinary visits.
cards.short_summary: A named Oregon athletics venue across the river from the main campus.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Oregon Athletics lists Autzen Stadium at 2700 MLK Jr. Blvd. in Eugene and provides official directions and event parking guidance.
cards.access_notes: 2700 MLK Jr. Blvd.; follow official event-specific parking and arrival instructions.

cards.title: Willamette Victorian house museum
cards.subtitle: Willamette Street corridor
cards.notes: Visit this documented historic house museum at 303 Willamette Street for a local-history outing. Check the museum’s tour and event schedule before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A City-owned Victorian house museum overlooking downtown Eugene.
cards.evidence_claim: The Shelton McMurphey Johnson House describes itself as a City of Eugene-owned Victorian house operated as a museum; the city lists it at 303 Willamette Street.
cards.source_title: About the Shelton McMurphey Johnson House
cards.access_notes: 303 Willamette Street; check the museum’s current tour and event schedule.
